findings: There is no independently verified PI0275 physical object task yet at the audited source. CPU preparation is not data generation.
A mature source removes the need to invent a free-tool controller, grasp scorer and task teacher for this first learning experiment.
Native absolute pd_ee_pose uses XYZ Euler, not axis-angle; source qpos field names do not replace actual command capture.
Training observations must come from the same EEF executor used by the learner, not unmatched source joint-control images.
Native gripper actuation fraction, commanded overclosure and measured physical opening are distinct quantities.
Full H40 data and noncorrective pose gates remain meaningful; native goal success cannot be used online to stop a drifting policy.
This is one skill with a fixed instruction. No new language-control, unseen-class or cross-embodiment claim is warranted.
